item.stem:
The diagram shows quadrilateral $ABCD$ with both pairs of opposite sides parallel. Sameer asks how rectangles and squares relate to parallelograms.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: $ABCD$ is a parallelogram; rectangles and squares are special parallelograms because their opposite sides are parallel.
options.B: $ABCD$ is a parallelogram only if all four angles are $90^{\circ}$.
options.D: The same rule classifies any open broken line of four segments as a parallelogram.
